name: Takamizawa Tsukasa
source:
Tsukasa is a full-time waiter at Cafe Lindbergh. He is exceptional at serving customers and acts as Itsuki's right-hand man with running the shop. He has a calm personality and appearance, always wearing a reserved smile. He is a strong person within, though he is not very strong with self-assertiveness and distances himself from others because he has trouble becoming emotionally close. He is also basically a lacto-vegetarian for mental reasons (though he doesn't like to, he will still eat fish).

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/cafe/cafe.php]Boys' Love Game Headquarters[/url]]
